note: Big Stone County park on the narrow neck between the two Toqua Lakes at Graceville, with a swimming beach, boat landing, ballfields and picnic shelters; a golf course is within walking distance. Seasonal sites are few, sold first-come by phone. --Claude
summary: County page + its RoverPass booking read: $25 + tax (confirmed), $150/week, tents $10; 18 sites 20/30/50 A, back-in, showers, dump; open Apr 22 - Nov 30 (RoverPass, was derived 04-25); booked online on RoverPass, 7-night limit confirmed. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (no site map; the campers visible sit 15-25 m from the lake behind a solid band of trees). Phone none -> 320-839-6373. Pin OK.
flags: Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade). No page gives a site map or site positions, so no site can be named within 50 m over open ground. Imagery: the campers visible in the park sit in the strip between County Hwy 18 and the north Toqua Lake west of the boat landing (about 45.55425,-96.44585 and 45.55415,-96.44630), 15-25 m from the water but under a continuous band of trees; others stand near the east ballfield (about 45.5554,-96.4398), ~60 m from the lake past the gravel lot. The listing's photos show the lake through trees from the picnic lawn. If AWH or a site map places numbered sites on the open lawn at the shore, lakefront can return with those sites named.
Season: stored opens 04-25 (derived) -> 04-22 per the county's RoverPass listing ('Open Dates: April 22 to November 30', updated 2026-11-10).

Booking platform: RoverPass is the county's own linked booking engine (claimed, isBookable true), not an aggregator table. Its rate table mislabels the nightly RV rate (shows '$10.00' daily for 'Electric Only' and '$25.00' under 'Seasonal'); the API price for a June 2027 night is $25.00, matching the county page.

Long-stay: seasonal ($1500) and after-Labor-Day ($375) passes exist, but 'Seasonal spots are limited' and 12 of the 18 sites are on nightly sale online, so it is not mostly seasonal. The 7-night rule applies to nightly campers.
Phone: none stored -> 320-839-6373 (the county page's park number; also the RoverPass park record).
Website: https://bigstonecounty.gov/parks/ confirmed; add the RoverPass booking link above as the booking line.
Pin 45.55413,-96.44319 sits on Hwy 18 at the park entrance by the boat landing, between the campers west and the ballfield east; OK.
